artifact.description: Retrieve the member_status (string) for a given member_id as shown in the member search results.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Member ID entered into the Member ID field to perform the search.

selection_context.use_when: When you need to retrieve a member's Status value from the member search results for a specific member ID. The caller must provide the member_id input.
selection_context.workflow_summary: Search for the member by ID in the Members area and return the Status field from the search results row that matches the provided member ID.
example_goals: What is the status of member 12345?
Find the account status for member 12345
Show the Status for member 12345 from the member search results
Get the status value for member 00001
